_comment: Copy to config.json and edit for your project. This example is real: the match strings, repo URLs, and own-repo exclusions for the agent-workspace-architecture + signal-sweep projects. Discovery is automated; engaging or correcting a mention is always a human gate (see the module README). context_terms = high-confidence corroborating tokens (author handle, doc names, distinctive phrases): a bare-name match is downgraded to 'name-unconfirmed' unless the thread body also carries a url/owner-path form or one of these, which kills coincidental-namesake noise.
